vetSays.line: 🛡️ Lauren, Larry, Bessie and Aroha met them at the door — 4 put down. Lauren, Larry, Bessie, Aroha are hurt.
🛡️ Bessie, Tikhon, Henry and Jovan met them at the door — 4 put down. Bessie, Tikhon, Henry, Jovan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Bessie, Pilar, Aroha, Dale and Henry met them at the door — 5 put down. Bessie, Pilar, Aroha, Dale, Henry are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lauren just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dale and Farid met them at the door — 2 put down. Dale is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pilar just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Pilar, Dale, Farid and Jesse met them at the door — 3 put down. Dale didn't come back. Farid, Jesse are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jovan just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aki just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Konstantin, Maya, Sigrun and Sam met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Konstantin, Maya, Sigrun, Sam are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Konstantin just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Konstantin, Aki and Sigrun met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Aki, Sigrun are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cheyenne just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
